data.name: VersionInstalled
data.value: Installed – updates come from the GitHub releases.

data.name: VersionNotInstalled
data.value: Not installed (a build): updates only reach a RepoBoard from the releases (Setup.exe or the portable zip).

data.name: CheckAutomatically_Hint
data.value: At start and while RepoBoard runs, asks GitHub whether a newer version is out and shows it in the top bar and once as a notification. Downloading and installing wait for your click.

data.name: Interval_Hint
data.value: Checks again this long after the last check, for when RepoBoard runs for days. Only with automatic checks on.

data.name: UpToDate
data.value: RepoBoard is up to date (checked at {0}).
data.comment: {0} = the time of the check, e.g. 09:30

data.name: Ready
data.value: Version {0} is downloaded – a restart installs it.

data.name: CheckTimedOut
data.value: GitHub did not answer within {0} s.

data.name: DownloadFailed
data.comment: {0} = the new version, {1} = the error message

data.name: Top_Available
data.comment: {0} = the new version; a button in the top bar

data.name: Top_Available_Hint
data.value: Show what is new in {0} and download it

data.name: Top_Ready
data.comment: {0} = the new version; a button in the top bar

data.name: Top_Ready_Hint
data.value: Ends RepoBoard, installs version {0} and starts it again.

data.name: YouHave
data.value: You have version {0}. What is new:

data.name: NotesOnlyTarget
data.value: Only the notes of {0} are known here; versions released in between, if any, are on GitHub.

data.name: RestartHint
data.value: After the download, “Restart now” ends RepoBoard, installs the update and starts it again. Repositories and settings stay.

data.name: Notify_Title
data.comment: {0} = the new version; title of the Windows notification

data.name: Notify_Text
data.value: Click to see what is new. Downloading and installing wait for your click.
